prayer: Prayer: Writ petition filed under Article 226 of Constitution of India for issuance of a direction particularly in the nature of writ of mandamus or any other appropriate order or direction directing the respondents to grant ordinary leave for 7 days without escort to the detenue Mr Sasikumar S/o Rajabader bearing PID No. 485459 presently incarcerated at Central Prison, Puzhal I, Chennai.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

Dr Anita Sumanth, J.:— The petitioner's son is the convict in Central Prison - I, Puzhal and has been lodged in prison since 5-3-1996. The petitioner's husband, convict's father, passed away on 22-5-2026 and the petitioner has made a request of leave for the convict to attend the 13th and 14th day ceremonies which fall on 6-6-2026 and 7-6-2026 respectively.

2. The Writ Petition has come up for admission and the ceremonies are slated to tomorrow and day after. In light of the fact that Mr C.R. Malarvannan, learned counsel for the Government of Tamil Nadu (Criminal Side) does not dispute the factum of demise of the convict's father, it would be only fair to permit the convict to attend the ceremonies as prayed for.

3. Hence, there is a direction to the authorities to permit the convict to go on leave with escort for two days, i.e, on 6-6-2026 and 7-6-2026, though on the following conditions:

(i) Respondents are directed to release the Convict Prisoner viz. Sasikumar, S/o. Rajabader, confined at Central Prison, Puzhal-I, Chennai on Ordinary Leave for 2 days i.e. 6-6-2026 and 7-6-2026 with escort.

(ii) The Convict Prisoner shall be released on 6-6-2026 at 10.00 a.m. and he shall surrender before the Central Prison, Puzhal-I on 7-6-2026 at 5.00 p.m.

4. This Writ Petition is allowed.
